# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem, design question, or final behavior.

## Product and compatibility

Identify affected commands, repository formats, policy concepts, protocols, security properties, or
released behavior. State whether each current behavior is retained, redesigned, or removed.

## Architecture

Explain what problem each new module or interface solves, why the responsibility belongs there, and
which concrete Quill behavior requires it. Do not justify a boundary only by analogy to the Go
implementation or to a common Rust pattern.

## Verification

List the exact commands or scenarios exercised and their observed results. If the branch does not
yet provide an applicable automated command, state the evidence reviewed instead.

## Migration

Describe any migration required for users, repository policy, persisted data, Pack authors, or
release tooling, or write `None`.

## Contribution provenance

- [ ] I disclosed all third-party material, including its source, copyright owner, and licence.
- [ ] I disclosed material whose authorship, ownership, or licensing status may be uncertain.
- [ ] I disclosed employer, university, client, funding, or confidentiality obligations that may
      affect my authority to contribute.

Provide details below, or write `None`.

## Contributor licence agreement

The automated CLA status check must pass before this pull request can be merged. No comment or
checkbox in this template constitutes acceptance of the CLA. If another person or legal entity owns
or may own the contribution, or if you are under 18, contact the maintainer instead of using the
standard individual signing process.
